description: This Java source file defines the PduComposer class, which is responsible for constructing and encoding various types of MMS PDUs (Protocol Data Units). It handles serialization of message headers, content, and multiple media parts for multimedia messaging service requests and responses.

classes.name: PduComposer
classes.description: Main class responsible for constructing and encoding MMS Protocol Data Units (PDUs), including message headers and multipart message content.

classes.name: BufferStack
classes.description: Inner class managing a stack of buffers to support nested message encoding contexts.

classes.name: LengthRecordNode
classes.description: Inner class representing a node to track message length and stack state during encoding.

classes.name: PositionMarker
classes.description: Inner class used for marking positions within the message and stack for length calculations.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Constructs the full PDU message byte array based on the message type, by calling specific methods for each type.

methods.name: appendHeader
methods.description: Appends the specified header field to the message buffer, encoding its value according to MMS specifications.

methods.name: makeSendReqPdu
methods.description: Constructs a Send Request PDU, including headers and message body.

methods.name: makeMessageBody
methods.description: Builds the message body part of the PDU, including multimedia parts and content type information.

methods.name: checkAddressType
methods.description: Checks the type of an address (phone number, email, IPv4, IPv6, or unknown) based on regex matching.
